name: findr
title: Findr
description: The fastest local file search for macOS. Finds what Finder can't. Searches filenames and file contents including PDFs.
author: nex_mod_daniel

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files
commands.description: Search files by name and content with unified ranking

preferences.name: findrPath
preferences.title: Findr Binary Path
preferences.description: Override the bundled findr binary. Leave empty to use the built-in engine.

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of search results to display

preferences.name: openrouterApiKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter API Key
preferences.description: Enable semantic search by providing your OpenRouter API key. Get one at openrouter.ai. Leave empty to use keyword search only.

preferences.name: scanScope
preferences.title: Scan Scope
preferences.description: Which directories to index. Requires Rebuild Index after changing.

preferences.name: customPaths
preferences.title: Additional Scan Paths
preferences.description: Comma-separated extra paths to scan, merged with the selected scope. Duplicates ignored. Example: ~/Code,/Volumes/External
